backup.production_rule: One new table (RLS on, service_role only), one new service_role read function and one job_heartbeats row. Nothing existing is altered. Take a fresh backup if this one is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: the_log_exists_with_rls_and_the_lock
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_class where oid = 'public.guest_message_log'::regclass and relrowsecurity) and exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.guest_message_log'::regclass and contype = 'p')

forward_verification.name: the_body_is_the_reviewed_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(prosrc) = 'e7d723364e6bb7d2c5cc06343eea7f57' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.due_guest_messages_v1(timestamptz)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: service_role_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('service_role','public.due_guest_messages_v1(timestamptz)','EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.due_guest_messages_v1(timestamptz)','EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.due_guest_messages_v1(timestamptz)','EXECUTE') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.guest_message_log','SELECT') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.guest_message_log','SELECT') and has_table_privilege('service_role','public.guest_message_log','INSERT')

forward_verification.name: the_heartbeat_row_is_seeded
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from public.job_heartbeats where job_name = 'guest-messages-hourly')

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20260926_guest_message_log.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh (unschedules guest-messages-hourly, drops the function and the table, removes the heartbeat row; export the log first if it has rows).
